Search field with a leading magnifier and an optional trailing keyboard-hint (the Gavel app-bar `⌘K` search). Controlled. Built on clicky tokens. When `onShortcut` is provided, a global cmd/ctrl+K listener is wired so the field can be focused from anywhere.

[Source](https://github.com/flanksource/clicky-ui/blob/main/packages/ui/src/components/SearchInput.tsx)

## Import

```tsx
import { SearchInput } from "@flanksource/clicky-ui/components";
```
